dedupe_keys.name: shandong city material flow accounts and reusable collection template 2017

description: These two workbooks combine a reusable material-flow collection template with worked accounts for sixteen cities in Shandong, China, in 2017. Researchers at Beijing Normal University, Tsinghua University and Qilu University of Technology define nine sectors and 155 material items covering fossil fuels, biomass and mineral materials. The files retain source statistics, preparation steps and conversion factors used to express inputs, recycling and disposal in tonnes. Mendeley version 4 provides both XLSX files free under CC BY-NC 3.0. The data licence differs from the more restrictive article copyright. Missing statistics require estimates, and some repeated quantities serve different conversion calculations; these are limitations for direct aggregation. Modellers could construct intersectoral flow matrices or adapt material-demand assumptions for urban circular-economy simulations. platform-openlca is a related material and environmental assessment tool, without a verified workbook importer. No cells, formulas or conversion factors were downloaded or recalculated.
